svg.title: Technology atlas
svg.desc: A knowledge graph of the whole laboratory. Twelve repositories sit on an outer ring grouped into four divisions, and the 19 technologies used by two or more of them float in the centre, each joined to every repository that uses it. The most shared are Python in 6 repositories, React in 6 repositories, FastAPI in 3 repositories.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Every technology used in more than one experiment, pulled toward the experiments that use it.
